Our Research team sits at the intersection of cutting-edge research and production systems, transforming raw audio into high-signal data for leading AI labs and enterprises. As a
**Research Engineer**

* Ability to translate research papers and ideas into high-quality, production-ready code.
* Experience deploying ML systems for production inference with cloud technologies.
* Ability to assess model quality in the context of user experience and business value.

* Experience with data curation, search and retrieval, embeddings, clustering, deduplication, or sampling.
* Experience building model inference systems or integrating pretrained models into production workflows.
* Experience in publishing in top conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, etc.
* Experience in releasing, maintaining, contributing to open-source softwares.
* PhD or Masters in Computer Science or a related field.
